**Draft — verification pending.** Local verification is incomplete. Protected verification with the canonical Comparator and all three kernels is requested for frozen head `ac76d5ef6008d976a7b8f3c1d921af2317e79ce9`.

The proposed result is **c = 0.1252270103**: every presented Dirichlet L-function is nonzero for **Re(s) > 0.8747729897**, with the principal pole excluded. The accompanying declarations give the Riemann zeta and stated Eisenstein Hecke consequences at the same strict boundary.

The proof follows one dependency chain: the accepted PR67 input, 64 seed source faces, the intermediate return, the selected 221 derived source faces and the final return. The committed Lean sources provide the proof and exact certificates, retaining the contributors' attribution and licenses. The standalone paper and exact download bundle are prepared for publication with the verification update.

I'm also sharing [QRH-Catalogue](https://github.com/HaileyStorm/QRH-Catalogue), the searchable catalogue of mathematical arguments and Lean components used extensively throughout this work. Its entries connect reusable results to their original sources and verification evidence.

**Hailey Collet** · [@HaileyStormC](https://x.com/HaileyStormC) · HaileyCollet@gmail.com

Hailey Collet is the sole human author. The research, drafting and Lean development were AI-assisted; the source notices retain the contribution account.
